scrubber_pipeline: Pass 1: cirislens_core.scrub_trace at level=full_traces — Rust v2 ort+INT8 DistilBERT-multilingual NER scoped to SCRUB_FIELDS subtrees + regex pass applied globally to all strings (year, year-bearing identifier, email, phone, IPv4, URL, SSN, credit card). Year-residue invariant rejects any trace with a 1700-2023 string-leaf in the scrubbed output (zero rejected on this corpus).

Pass 2: spaCy en_core_web_sm with placeholder-mask protection. Redacts PERSON / ORG / GPE / LOC / FAC / NORP / DATE / TIME / EVENT / WORK_OF_ART / LAW spans on all strings, routing strings with substantial non-Latin content (≥5% or ≥3 non-Latin chars) to xx_ent_wiki_sm (multilingual) instead.
Pass 3: post-pass year-residue check on the final scrubbed output (verified zero across reasoning-text files).
filter_rules: timestamp >= 2026-03-22 (HF release cutoff; pre-cutoff sparse-field traces dropped)

known_residual.concentration: agent-meta-reasoning fields (aspdma_prompt, dsdma.prompt_used, current_thought_summary.content, idma_result.prompt_used and recovery fields). Not user content.
known_residual.explanation: Four mechanistic NER models (DistilBERT-multilingual INT8, regex, spaCy en_core_web_sm, spaCy xx_ent_wiki_sm) converge on missing certain named-entity classes in dense-prompt context with embedded placeholders. The residual is preserved rather than removed via topic-specific regex because the methodology is mechanistic and reproducible: same source + same pinned models = bytewise-identical output. A topic blacklist would defeat that property.
